column1: # THE ROSARIO CONFIRMATIONS - OPENED FOR THE FIRST TIME, 14 September 2026.
# "Confirmaciones 1883-1918, 1920-1961", film 1091419, DGS 4531018. 421 images, unrestricted.
# This register has been listed as UNTRIED since the first week of this archive and had no film
# number until 13 September 2026. It was opened that day and served no tiles - which turned out to
# be part of a FamilySearch outage, not a restriction. It opens normally now.
# *** WHY IT MATTERS: A CONFIRMATION ACT NAMES THE PARENTS. *** Pablo Armando was born in February
# 1882. The children confirmed at Rosario in March 1890 are aged six to fifteen, so he is squarely
# in range - and his parents Juan Carlos Lerena and Maria Lerena are the whole question.
# STRUCTURE, established on the first page read (film 004531018, ?i=10):
#   "En el dia 26 de Marzo de 1890 en Rosario ... el Ilmo. Sr. Obispo ... administro el Sacramento
#    de la Confirmacion a los siguientes:"
#   then a NUMBERED LIST, about 45 to a page in two columns, each entry reading:
#   <number> <given name>, de <age> anos, hijo/hija leg. de <father> y <mother>. M[adrina] <sponsor>
#   *** THE ENTRIES CARRY ONLY A GIVEN NAME - THE SURNAME IS NOT WRITTEN. *** It has to be read out
#   of the FATHER'S name. So this register cannot be scanned for "Lerena" in a margin the way the
#   baptisms were; every line must be read. Legible at DeepZoom level 12, which is the maximum.

column1: # *** A CORRECTION, MADE THE SAME DAY AS THE MISTAKE. ***
# Earlier today this file recorded, from the first eleven entries, that "EVERY ENTRY ON THIS PAGE IS
# A GIRL ... if the confirmations were taken sex by sex, a boy of eight would be in a separate run of
# pages, and that is where to look for him." *** THAT IS WRONG. ***
# Entries 133, 135 and 138 are Domingo, Santiago and Pablo, all "HIJO leg. de" - boys, mixed straight
# in among the girls. The first eleven entries happened to be girls and I built a structure out of
# eleven rows. There is NO separate boys' section to find, and therefore no shortcut: the whole list
# has to be read.
# The ages run from TWO to FOURTEEN in the same sitting, so confirmation here was not at a fixed age
# either. A child of eight in 1890 is unremarkable in this list, which is the point - it means Pablo
# Armando cannot be ruled in or out by age, only by being read for.
# RESUME AT: film 004531018, ?i=12, ?i=14, then ?i=16 onward.
# Read so far: the 26 March 1890 list at entries 1-88, 133-177 and 222-243; and entries 1-7 of the
# second 1890 sitting (June-July). *** No Lerena in any of them. ***
# SCALE, now that two sittings are visible: the March list alone exceeds 243 children, and there is
# a second sitting the same year. Across 421 images and thirty-five years this is many thousands of
# entries, each one to be read rather than scanned - because the surname is only in the father's
# name, never in a margin.
